revisions.title: Speeches about what? Pinning down the subject matter
revisions.body: Gorgias agrees to short answers, and Socrates presses the defining question: rhetoric works through speech, but so do arithmetic and medicine. He asks what rhetoric's speeches concern, using comparison with other arts to force a subject matter into view.

revisions.title: A logos you will call a mythos: naked souls judged
revisions.body: Socrates introduces the account as a logos that Callicles may call a mythos. Zeus reforms the courts of the dead because judgments failed when souls arrived clothed in bodies and wealth and accompanied by witnesses. The dead now stand naked, soul scrutinizing soul.
